name: Vlad Vasile-Voiculescu - § 24 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: 24. Calls on the Commission, in the context of the revision of the Tobacco Advertising Directive, to ensure that the framework is updated to effectively address advertising, promotion and sponsorship practices on digital and social media platforms and to cover all new and emerging tobacco and nicotine products; stresses the need to close enforcement gaps, strengthen the protection of minors and tackle marketing practices, including in relation to smoking devices that increase product appeal among young people and non-smokers; further emphasises the need for the introduction of measures to eliminate indirect marketing practices and reduce product appeal, particularly towards minors, with due respect for national competencies;
